about_the_game:
AVTale – is an exciting cooperative 2D platformer designed for two players on a single screen (Split Screen) locally and online, where teamwork is the key to escaping a bottomless cave where echoes of ancient mysteries blend with the whispers of shadows. The game features a dark-toned atmosphere where lighting plays a crucial role and offers dynamic battles, challenging puzzles, and a world filled with dangers.

Co-op as the Key to Survival

The game is built to emphasize the importance of player interaction. One player takes on the role of support, using healing, shields, and buffs, while the other focuses on offense, fighting enemies. Only through teamwork can they succeed.

Features:

  • Online co-op - fight with your friends online!

  • Split screen co-op gameplay – play together on one PC using gamepads or keyboard.

  • Two unique playstyles – support and attack, combine your strengths!

  • Engaging puzzles – requiring coordination and teamwork.

  • Dynamic combat – numerous respawning monsters and real-time battles.

  • Atmospheric world – a dark, mysterious cave with stunning locations.

  • A survival story – the heroes search for an exit and discover a magical stone that guides them forward.

  • Time-based challenge – each level is played against the clock, pushing players to act quickly and efficiently.

  • Performance comparison – at the end of the game, players find out which style dominated: the steadfast warrior or the devoted protector.

Are you ready to trust your partner and escape the darkness?

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce 9600 GT or AMD HD 3870 512MB or higher
  • DirectX: Version 9.0

  • OS *: Windows 7+
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2500

short_description: AVTale is a cooperative platformer for two players on one screen or online. Two heroes find themselves in a dark cave full of secrets and dangers. One can only fight, the other can support the ally. Together, solve puzzles, fight monsters and much more!
supported_languages:
English*, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian*, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese
*languages with full audio support
